dedup.scope: Targeted neighbours only: the public identity index, the retired-claims record and every card in focused-seeds carrying this chapter's source id, plus the occupancy scan this lane runs before opening any card. The chapter is assigned to this line alone by the claims table.
compared: The chapter stacks-topology is assigned to this line (lane-p1, prefix P1-) as the entire source by the claims table, so no other line mines the same labels.

Before opening, this lane classifies every interval hit against other cards and the public index as FULL / INSIDE / PARTIAL / ADJACENT; only FULL and INSIDE are treated as duplicates and the partial cases are reported for a ruling.
The other cards this line opens on this chapter are the P1- registrations in operations/new-material-registrations/.
